headline: Fire breaks out at Khulna City Medical College and Hospital
summary: A fire erupted at the 17-story Khulna City Medical College and Hospital on Thursday night. Twelve fire units are currently working to control the blaze, which originated on the ground floor.
details: A fire broke out at the private Khulna City Medical College and Hospital on Thursday night at 9:33 PM. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are not yet known.

caption:
Fire engulfs Khulna City Medical College and Hospital.
Twelve fire units are battling the blaze.

A fire broke out at the private Khulna City Medical College and Hospital on Thursday night at 9:33 PM. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are not yet known.

The fire service received the report of the fire at 9:35 PM and dispatched units from the Khulna Sadar Fire Station. They arrived at the scene at 9:40 PM and began efforts to extinguish the flames.

Preliminary reports indicate that the fire originated on the ground floor of the 17-story building. Twelve fire units from the Khulna Sadar Fire Station are engaged in controlling the situation.

#Khulna #Fire #Bangladesh #Hospital #BreakingNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo, Somoy News
